info.value: atra prARigrahaRamatantram . tena ' prasUnAstaravaH iti Bavati ' iti mADavaH .

examples: 'yaTA SUdro brAhmaRyAM bAhyaM jantuM prasUyate' (manu॰10.30). janayatItyarTaH.
'tadvaH sarvaM pravakzyAmi prasave ca guRAguRAn' (manu॰3.22). prasave=santAne'patyezu.
'sUSca me prasUSca me' (vA॰saM॰18.7). sUH putrAdipreraRasAmarTyam. prasUH putrotpattyAdisAmarTyam.
'bfhaspatiprasUto yajamAnaH' (tE0 saM0 1.6.1.1). prasUto'ByanujYAtaH. zu prasavESvaryayorityatra DAtvarTanirdeSe prasavo'ByanujYAnamAheti vivarItAraH.
'idamahaM bfhaspateH sadasi sIdAmi prasUto devena savitrA' (kA0 SrO0 2.2.1). uktorTaH.
'pravAtsu Gorezvapi mArutezu na hyaprasUtAstaravaScalanti' (sOndara0 16.10). aprasUtA ajAtA anudBUtAH.
'saMskftaM prasavaM yAti' (BA0 vana0 3.82). saMskftaM pakvamannaM varData ityarTaH.
'taravo BUrivarzmARaH prAsUyanta maDucyutaH' (BA0 pu0 4.19.8). prAsUyanta puzpaPale udapAdayannityarTaH. taTA cAmaraH paWati--syAdutpAde Pale puzpe prasavo garBamocane iti.
'tamutsave prasave ca sAhasim' (f0 1.102.1). utsavaH prakramaH prAramBaH. utsUta utsUyate vA harzamityutsavo mahaH.
'puruzArTaSUnyAnAM guRAnAM pratiprasavaH' (yo0 sU0 4.34). pratiprasavaH svakAraRe praDAne laya iti tattvavESAradI.
